messages:
vivian: New hire hit a schema.validate failure while running the Node onboarding sample. The JSON-mode helper returned a JSON string on a retry after auth refresh. Repro below.

vivian: Node repro:
```
const res = await sdk.callTool('annotate', {text})
// expected: {annotations: [...] } (object)
// actual on retry: \"{\\\"annotations\\\":[...]}\" (string)
```

omar: I can repro. Looks like the retry path returns the raw body and skips the parse pipeline. First request gives object, retry gives string.

kevin: Short-term mitigation: add a small normalization guard in the sample (if typeof result === 'string' try JSON.parse) and a README note for onboarding. Long-term: SDK must guarantee native types for structured outputs across main/retry paths and languages.

omar: I'll open a PR to make retry call the same parse function as the main path and add unit tests that simulate 401 + token refresh.

vivian: Can we also add a CI smoke that runs the sample repro with a stubbed refresh endpoint so we catch regressions? New hires keep filing this.

support-bot: Created issue #1702: "json-mode: normalize structured outputs on retry (auth refresh)" 0. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/1702

omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1023 0 (node fix + tests). I'll follow up with a python patch after.

kevin: Please add a one-line onboarding checklist item: "Run sample repro with expired token to validate SDK normalization" and a short DX spec: helper returns native dict/list/primitive types, never raw JSON strings or bytes for structured outputs.

vivian: Thanks team. Once both PRs are merged I'll update onboarding docs and ping support to close tickets.
